# llms.txt for cmmshere.com

CMMShere is a comprehensive Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) designed to help organizations efficiently manage, monitor, and optimize their maintenance operations.
Our platform is tailored for industries of all sizes, enabling preventive maintenance scheduling, real-time asset monitoring, work order management, cost control, and performance analytics — all in one easy-to-use system.

## About CMMShere
- **Type:** Software as a Service (SaaS) CMMS / GMAO (Gestión de Mantenimiento Asistido por Ordenador)
- **Key Features:** Asset tracking, preventive and corrective maintenance, work orders, budgets, KPI dashboards, multi-language interface.
- **Industries Served:** Manufacturing, healthcare, energy, transportation, facilities management, SMEs and large corporations.
- **Value Proposition:** Reduce downtime, extend asset lifespan, and improve operational efficiency through automation and data-driven insights.
- **Languages Available:** English, Español (Spanish)
